items.item: Old frame and history (E1, E10, D5, D7)
items.how: A scan of every current field in all 536 records and the six data files found no 'unasserted', 'warrant open', 'neither asserted', 'binds no one', 'C gives order', 'rests on C' or 依 C, and no 定范围/定次序 as roles. What remains: history (lineage points, papers[8]'s dated clause, the arcs' account of 33 and 49), other senses (稳定范围, 'two readings' of a rule's pool, 地位 as status in old entries), and 'C read as widening' (see 'left'). No history field, dated note or verbatim quote was edited. No person is named. Nothing says no one has read the work.

words.{en,zh}.arc_short opens the lineage page's ten-minute part. It told the October separation of 'its rankings' scope and order (the continuation condition and C)' as a step taken, then 'On 9 November T8 ... becomes its makers' offer', with no word that the frame was withdrawn that day. The full arc and the ethics thread say it. A reader of the brief would believe the two-premise frame stands. The last sentence now opens 'On 9 November C stops being a second premise, the ethics emerging from continuation, and the working rules turn to the map ...'. The zh reads 11 月 9 日，C 不再是第二个前提，伦理从延续中生出；工作规则转向地图. The brief stays at 240 words, the test's cap. T8's event stays in the full arc and thread at point 49.

'the second, widening is better (C), it withdrew as a premise' became 'and withdrew the second, widening is better (C), as a premise'. Its ranking clause now carries '(self-concern, a hypothesis in the proofs)' (zh （自我关切，在证明中为假设）), as papers[2] does (F1).
The English had no verb: 'and practical judgment premises of its own'. It now reads 'has premises of its own'. The zh was already right.

The new zh lines are natural in each record's register (the classical 排序之果陈述其定理所取之次序 in the terse records, the plain form in the data files) and say what the English says. The F5 wording (伦理不在生灭变化之外寻求权威……本论既不主张也不裁定) is consistent across the edge record, the standard boundary, the chain and positioned-positive-reason. Two forms of de se are in use: 以自承成立 in records and lineage, 以从己方式 in arguments-a-l and the glossary. Both are existing usage, a low finding.
